Cashu Card is built by a very small team and paid for out of pocket. Gifts pay for development, testing, and security work, and every sat appears in the public ledger on this page.

02 / Larger gifts

Grants and larger gifts

Foundations and companies that want to fund a specific piece of work, such as an independent security review, can write to us. We send a one-page scope with the deliverable, the reviewer or vendor, the timeline, and what gets published at the end. Reviews and test reports funded this way are published in full in the repository.

Write to hello@cashucard.org

The work so far was carried by grants from The Reynolds Foundation and the Human Rights Foundation under Project Island Resilience, and by Flash and Island Bitcoin.

03 / Beyond sats

Other ways to help

Gifts pay for time on the work. Scrutiny, code, and real use in the field help just as much.

  • Break itAudit the applet, the host code, and the draft NUT, and report what you find to security@cashucard.org.
  • Build on itAdd card support to your wallet or till. The developer page has the protocol, the simulator, and the test vectors.
  • Issue cardsRun cards on your own mint with the install guide and an operator account, load small amounts, and tell us what fails.
  • Talk about itQuestions and ideas go in GitHub Discussions.
